sections.changelog:
1.0.10

  • Added printable PDF signature labels (tejuelos) from the Books list, with configurable A4 label layout settings.
  • Librarians can use the WordPress Media Library to browse, select, and upload files.
  • Improved automatic title signatures by ignoring initial articles, pronouns, and short words.
  • Fixed recurring-event dates on event detail pages by calculating weekly occurrences in the WordPress site timezone.
